files.description: Quiz results (80 rows, one per student in seat order, no other columns): quiz_a and quiz_b (points 0-10, whole numbers, many equal values; about 9% and 6% of cells empty for absent students).

task_text: Convert the table to the best-fitting column types after reading, so that the scores stay whole numbers with empty cells. Rank the students in quiz_b from the lowest score (rank 1 = lowest; equal scores share the average of their ranks). Absent students (empty cell) get no rank. `result` should be a Series with one rank per student in file order.
intended_computation: Average ascending ranks of the 75 non-empty quiz_b scores, missing for the 5 absent students; 80 values.

acceptable_variants.notes: missing values in any null representation.

predicted_direction.reason: rank() on the nullable column ranked the absent students on 2.x and moved all ranks up; on 3.x they stay missing, as requested.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row N06; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
